description: Schema example. Not a recording. Copy to data/private_eval/labels.json after the consent and redaction checklists.

consent.purpose: Local perception evaluation of a short clip for this research prototype. Not for publishing the media, not for training a released model, and not a street-performance claim.
consent.retention: Replace with where the file stays and when it is deleted. Do not name the participant.
consent.access: Replace with who on this machine can open the file. Do not upload it or send it to CI.
consent.withdrawal: Replace with how a participant asks for deletion. Do not put a name, phone number, or address in this file.

clips.description: Replace the path with a private file or a directory of stills. This placeholder is not media.

samples.confidence_note: Example only. Say what is in the frame and why the label is sure or not. Do not name a person or a place.
